map.近似到期收益率 YTM = [年利息 C + (面值 F − 价格 P) ÷ 剩: Approximate yield to maturity YTM = [annual interest C + (face value F − price P) ÷ remaining years n] ÷ [(F + P) ÷ 2], i.e. annual interest plus amortized capital gain divided by average invested cost, ×100 shown as a percentage (2 decimals). Validation: non-empty numeric guards for C, F, P and n (the chart curve uses the same formula, with an extra denominator <10⁻¹² guard). Criteria: when the price is below face value the YTM is above the coupon rate, and buying at a premium puts it below the coupon rate.
